parsed.scene_summary: I stand in a crowded MTR train car holding my smartphone, watching a Bilibili video about on-demand bus services, and comment aloud as the train arrives at Kowloon Tong station.

segments.action: I hold my smartphone in my right hand and watch a video on Bilibili while standing inside a crowded train.
segments.environment:
a) PHYSICAL SPACE: Interior of a crowded train car (Hong Kong MTR) with multiple passengers standing close together, holding handrails and overhead straps. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting.
b) OBJECTS: Smartphone in a yellow protective case held in my right hand; passengers around wearing backpacks, shoulder bags, and casual attire.
c) SCREEN CONTENT: Smartphone displays the Bilibili video page titled '巡游公交简介及体验【vlog36】' with text '海滨小城市为何也要打造网约巡游公交？北海网约...'. Status bar time reads 7:27.
d) TEXT IN THE WORLD: On-screen Bilibili interface text '巡游公交简介及体验【vlog36】'.
e) MEDIA BEING PLAYED: A video on Bilibili explaining on-demand bus services in Beihai.
f) AMBIENT AUDIO: Background train motion hum and passenger ambient murmur.
text_visible: 海滨小城市为何也要打造网约巡游公交？
segments.details: I hold the phone with my right hand in portrait mode, looking down at the video player.

segments.action: I continue watching the Bilibili video on my smartphone screen while keeping my gaze on the player area.
segments.environment: No change.
segments.details: I maintain focus on the video playback.

segments.action: I scroll down slightly on my phone screen to look at video recommendations and details.
segments.environment: The phone screen scrolls down, revealing video details and recommended video thumbnails below the main video player.
segments.details: My thumb moves up the screen to scroll down the page.

segments.action: I express my reaction aloud while reading the title '网约巡游公交' on my phone.
segments.environment: No change.
segments.details: I say '网约公交，我操，有点帅。' in reaction to the video concept while continuing to look at the screen.

segments.action: I hold my phone in hand as the train slows down and arrives at Kowloon Tong station.
segments.environment: The MTR train arrives at the platform, and the station wall signage '九龍塘 Kowloon Tong' becomes visible outside the train glass doors.
segments.details: The train slows down and stops, revealing the station name sign outside.

segments.environment: The video player active content displays documentary footage of European dining scenes and modern architectural interiors with sequential subtitles: '众所周知', '欧洲尤其是北欧很多国家的社会福利高到令人发指', '居民从出生到养老，从教育到医疗', '政府全都给予高额补贴', and '政府发放的失业保险金、社会救济金等一系列保障金都能让你一直躺平在家'.

segments.action: I hold my phone in my right hand and watch a Bilibili video explaining how Nordic governments levy high income and corporate taxes to redistribute wealth.
segments.action_brief: I watch a Bilibili video about Nordic tax redistribution.
segments.environment:
PHYSICAL SPACE: Inside a brightly lit, crowded metro train carriage (MTR) traveling along the track. Overhead handrails, glass doors, and safety signage are visible. Several passengers stand closely packed around me: a young boy in a pale yellow t-shirt stands beside me looking at his own phone; a passenger in a striped t-shirt and blue crossbody bag stands behind him holding an overhead handle; a woman in a white blouse stands to the left holding her phone with a paper shopping bag ('SALAD') slung over her arm; another passenger wears a pink polka-dot vest.
OBJECTS: In my right hand is an iPhone in a yellow-rimmed case. Below it is the dark top of my clothing/lap. Around me are passenger phones, bags, and carriage grab poles.
SCREEN CONTENT: On my smartphone, Bilibili is open in portrait mode. The top half displays a video playing with subtitles ('也有人讲是因为这些国家的再分配做的好', '政府向高收入群体收取最高60%的个人所得税和企业所得税用来进行财富再平衡') alongside scrolling danmaku comments. The bottom half shows the video comment section featuring a top comment discussing tax rates in Germany and Switzerland, with a reply input box at the very bottom.
TEXT IN THE WORLD: MTR door caution signs '請小心月台空隙' (Mind the gap) and '當車門正在關閉 請勿上/落車'.
MEDIA PLAYING: Bilibili video commentary narrating the taxation and redistribution policies of high-welfare European countries.
AMBIENT AUDIO: Video narrator voice, faint train movement rumbling, and MTR carriage automated announcements ('請小心月台空隙').
text_visible: 政府向高收入群体收取最高60%的个人所得税和企业所得税用来进行财富再平衡

德国63欧一个月，邻居瑞士680欧一个月
segments.details: I hold my phone steadily in front of me at chest height, watching the video playback while glancing at the subtitle lines explaining government tax collection up to 60%.

segments.action: I watch the video argue that high taxation is merely an outcome rather than the root cause of wealth, while reading scrolling danmaku comments.
segments.action_brief: I watch the video explanation on wealth causes and read danmaku.
segments.environment: The Bilibili video subtitles update to '但这也只是结果而不是原因' and '并没有解释钱从哪里来的问题'. Multiple danmaku comments stream across the screen discussing historical wealth accumulation ('祖上掠夺财富', '怎么才60%', '分配制度').

screen_text.label: Claude chat window showing Lovász Local Lemma notes
text: 整理三个定理的证明思路和应用细节。
下面我逐一把讲义中LLL的三个应用展开，把每一步的动机、构造、验证条件和结论都讲清楚。
超图 H = (V, E)：V 是有限顶点集，E 是 V 的若干子集（超边），每条超边可以有2个或更多顶点（普通图的边恰好是大小为2的超边）。
性质B（Property B）：是否能对V做一个红/蓝2-着色，使得每条超边都不单色——也就是每条边里既有红点也有蓝点。
Theorem 33. 设超图 H = (V, E) 满足
1. 每条超边至少含k个顶点；
2. 每条超边最多与d条其他超边相交（即共用至少一个顶点）。
若 e(d + 1) ≤ 2^{k-1}，则 H 有性质 B。
